privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.p1: NimStamp is a loyalty tool that runs inside Nimiq Pay. We collect the minimum needed to count stamps and prevent abuse.
privacy.c1: Your NIM address (public on the blockchain anyway) and the loyalty cards linked to it.
privacy.c2: A pseudonymous device identifier provided by Nimiq Pay (a hash, scoped to this app), only if you accept the prompt. It is used to limit the number of cards per device per business.
privacy.c3: Business name and city entered by merchants.
privacy.c4: A hashed IP address for 24 hours when no device identifier is available, to limit card creation.
privacy.c5: Transaction hashes, amounts and timestamps of payments that earned stamps, and redemption codes.
privacy.n1: No emails, phone numbers or names of customers. No analytics SDKs, no advertising trackers, no cookies.
privacy.why: Loyalty accounting (counting stamps and rewards) and abuse prevention (duplicate cards, replayed payments).
privacy.retention: Activity records are kept for 12 months. Hashed IPs are deleted after 24 hours. Sign-in sessions expire after 30 days.
privacy.contact: Questions or deletion requests: open an issue on the GitHub repository linked in the footer.
